label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Activity for Year, Maximum Outstanding at any Month End
description: The maximum balance outstanding at any month end during the period as of the Balance Sheet date.

label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Commitment Fees
description: Amount of unearned commitment fees on advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Repayment and Penalties
description: Amount of repayments and penalties incurred in the satisfaction or roll-over of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) advance.

label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Interest Rate
description: Interest rate of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Par Value
description: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

label: Fees and Commissions, Credit and Debit Cards (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Finance Lease, Impairment Loss
description: Amount of impairment loss from right-of-use asset from finance lease.

label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Next Rolling Twelve Months
description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease due in next rolling 12 months following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling after Year Five
description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Equities, at Fair Value
description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in corporate stocks (common and preferred), stock options, warrants and any other financial instrument which represents, or provides the ability to obtain, ownership rights in a corporation. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

label: Financial Services Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestModified
description: Amount of accrued interest on financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestNoncurrent
description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossLoanPurchased
description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss for financing receivable from purchased loan classified as other. Excludes financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration, purchased seasoned loan, loan acquired through business combination or acquisition, and net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossLoanSold
description: Amount of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from sale of loan. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityYearOne
description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

label: Financing Receivable, Covered and Not Covered, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Fee, Premium, and Discount
description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss and unamortized deferred fee, premium, and discount, of financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and financing receivable not covered under loss sharing agreement.

label: Financing Receivable, Deferred Commitment Fee
description: Amount of fee received for commitment to originate or purchase financing receivable where likelihood of commitment being exercised is remote, to be recognized as service income.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterest90DaysOrMorePastDueStillAccruing
description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable 90 days or more past due and still accruing. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossForeignCurrencyTranslation
description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossLoanPurchased
description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from purchase of loan. Excludes financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration, loan acquired through business combination or acquisition, and net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestModifiedAccumulated
description: Accumulated amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestModifiedIncreaseDecreaseFromModification
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestModifiedPast12Months
description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable 12 months after modification for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestPurchase
description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of increase in financing receivable from purchase. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestReclassificationToHeldForSale
description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable reclassified to held-for-sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestSale
description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of decrease in financing receivable from sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestTransferToHeldForInvestmentAllowanceForCreditLossExpense
description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense on financing receivable transferred into held-for-investment out of held-for-sale classification. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableModificationToTotalFinancingReceivablesPercent
description: Percentage of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty to total financing receivables.

label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Number of Contracts (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Modifications, Pre-Modification Recorded Investment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Modifications, Subsequent Default, Recorded Investment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
FinancingReceivableModifiedPast12Months
description: Amortized cost of financing receivable 12 months after modification for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

label: FinancingReceivableModifiedWeightedAverageInterestRateDecreaseFromModification
description: Percentage of decrease in weighted-average contractual interest rate of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, Percent Past Due (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, Percent Past Due
description: Percentage of nonaccrual financing receivable balance outstanding that is past due.

label: Financing Receivable, Percent Past Due (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Percent Past Due
description: Percentage of financing receivable balance that is past due.

label: Financing Receivable, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Amount at Purchase Price
description: Amount at purchase price of financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration.

label: Financing Receivable, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Discount (Premium)
description: Amount of discount (premium) attributable to other factors on financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration.

label: Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, 1 to 29 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Revolving
description: Amortized cost of financing receivable that can be withdrawn, repaid, and redrawn.

label: Financing Receivable, Revolving, Converted to Term Loan
description: Amortized cost of revolving financing receivable converted to term loan.

label: Financing Receivable, Revolving, Converted to Term Loan During Period
description: Amount of increase in term loan from conversion of revolving financing receivable.

label: FinancingReceivableRevolvingConvertedToTermLoanWriteoff
description: Amount of writeoff of revolving financing receivable converted to term loan.

label: FinancingReceivableSale
description: Amount of decrease in financing receivable from sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

label: FinancingReceivableTransferToHeldForSaleValuationAllowanceExpense
description: Amount of expense for valuation allowance on financing receivable transferred to held-for-sale classification.

label: Finite-Lived Trademarks, Gross
description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a specified period of time.

label: Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Three (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal after Year Five (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Five (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Four (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Two (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Next Twelve Months (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Floor Brokerage, Exchange and Clearance Fees
description: The amount of expense during the period for floor brokerage fees paid to other broker-dealers to execute trades on their behalf, stock exchange fees, order flow fees, and clearance fees.

label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net
description: The amount of net gains or losses on foreign currency cash flow hedges reclassified during the period to earnings from accumulated other comprehensive income upon the hedged transaction affecting earnings.

label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified During Next 12 Months
description: The estimated net amount of unrealized gains or losses on foreign currency cash flow hedges at the reporting date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next 12 months.

label: Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments at Fair Value, Net
description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

label: Foreign Currency Exchange Rate, Translation (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Asset at Fair Value
description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

label: Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivatives designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

label: Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

label: ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealizedAfterTax
description: Amount, after tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

label: Foreign Financial Institutions, Actual Deposits
description: The amount of deposits held by branches of foreign institutions.

label: Former Gain Contingency, Recognized in Current Period
description: Amount of gain recognized in the period that had been disclosed in prior periods as a contingent gain.

label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Indexed Shares
description: The number of issuer's shares to which the forward contract is indexed.

label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Alternatives, Shares, at Fair Value
description: Number of shares as a settlement alternative for each freestanding forward contract.

label: Franchisor Costs
description: Aggregate costs incurred that are directly related to activities, including but not limited to, generating franchise revenues from franchisor owned outlets and franchised outlets.

label: Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Additional Paid-in Capital
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Assets
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Cash and Cash Equivalents
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Common Stock
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Current
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Liabilities
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Liabilities and Stockholders' Equity
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Long-term Debt
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Other Assets
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Preferred Stock
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Property and Equipment, Net
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Stockholders' Equity
Funds Held for Clients
description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the funds held on behalf of others and that are expected to be liquidated within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. This does not include funds held under reinsurance agreements.

label: Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Asset
description: Amount of the reinsurer's funds held on its behalf by the ceding insurer, including funds held in trust, under reinsurance treaties or contracts with the assuming insurer as security for the payment of the obligations thereunder.

label: Gain Contingency, Unrecorded Amount
description: The amount or range of possible amounts of gain that could be realized upon the resolution of a contingency.

label: Gain from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
description: The gain relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

label: Gain (Loss) from Price Risk Management Activity
description: Gain (loss) incurred in risk management activities.

label: Gain (Loss) from Sale of Financial Assets in Securitizations or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Gain (Loss) on Credit Risk Derivatives, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivatives
description: Amount of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedge recognized in earnings and from related hedged item to extent that fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivatives, Net
description: The aggregate net gain (loss) on price risk derivatives included in earnings in the period.

label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Capital Leases, Net
description: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's transactions involving the sale, transfer, or termination of financing agreements classified as capital leases.

label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Interest in Projects
description: Gain (loss) included in earnings resulting from the sale of interest in projects.

label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases
description: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's sale of assets held- or available-for-lease under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases.

label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Subsidiary or Equity Investee, Nonoperating Income
description: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by subsidiaries or equity investees made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Project
description: The gains and losses included in earning resulting from the sale of a project.

label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Proved Property
description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property with proven oil and gas reserves.

label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Timber Property
description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property used for growing and harvesting trees.

label: Gain on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
description: The amount of gain reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

label: Gain on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness
description: Amount of gain recognized in the income statement from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

label: Gas and Oil Area, Developed, Gross
Gas and Oil Area, Undeveloped, Gross
General Contractor Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
General Contractor Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
General Partner Distributions
description: Distributions from earnings to the general partner of a partnership included in the consolidated financial statements.

label: General Partners' Capital Account, Period Distribution Amount
description: The total amount of distributions to the general partner during the period.

label: Goodwill, Allocation Adjustment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Goodwill, Subsequent Recognition of Deferred Tax Asset
description: Amount of (increase) decrease from subsequent recognition of deferred tax asset for asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

label: GovernmentAssistanceAmount
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance.

label: Guarantor Obligations, Liquidation Proceeds, Monetary Amount
description: Indicates, if estimable, the approximate extent to which the proceeds from liquidation of any assets held either as collateral or by third parties would be expected to cover the maximum potential amount of future payments under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

label: Guaranty Assets
description: The carrying amount of the contractual right to receive fees, as compensation in exchange for providing a guarantee to a third party, over life of the guarantee.

label: Haircuts on Contractual Securities Commitments (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Health Care Organization, Expenses, Gross
description: Total expenses of a HCO before stop-loss insurance recoveries. Costs of services rendered (including costs of services rendered but not yet reported).

label: Health Care Organization, Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Hedged Liability, Fair Value Hedge, Cumulative Increase (Decrease)
description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in fair value of hedged liability in fair value hedge, attributable to hedged risk. Excludes cumulative basis adjustment related to foreign exchange risk.

label: Hedging Assets, Current
description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

label: Hedging Assets, Noncurrent
description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to hedge price changes in underlying assets, and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

label: Hedging Liabilities, Noncurrent
description: Fair value of liability arising from a financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Restricted
description: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Sold Security, at Carrying Value (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Transferred Security, at Carrying Value (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Transfer, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) from transfer of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Transferred to Available-for-sale Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Unrecognized Holding Loss (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, after Accumulated Amortization
description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Average Recorded Investment
description: Amount of average investment of impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Interest Income, Accrual Method
description: Amount of interest income, recognized on accrual basis, on financing receivables, for which there is a related allowance for credit losses and are recognized as impaired.

label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Interest Income, Cash Basis Method
description: Amount of interest income on financing receivables, for which there is a related allowance for credit losses, recognized on a cash-basis method of accounting that the financing receivables were impaired.

label: ImpairmentExcludingLessorAssetUnderOperatingLease
description: Amount, excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of impairment loss for long-lived asset held and used.

label: Incentive Distribution, Distribution Per Unit
description: Per-share or per-unit amount of incentive dividend declared and paid to managing member or general partner.

label: Income (Loss) before Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
description: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.

label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
description: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder in a publicly trade limited partnership (LP) or master limited partnership (MLP).

label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted
description: The amount of income (loss) derived from discontinued operations during the period, net of related tax effect, per each basic and diluted limited partnership and general partnership unit when the per unit amount is the same for both basic and diluted units.

label: Income (Loss) from Individually Significant Component Disposed of or Held-for-sale, Excluding Discontinued Operations, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Income Tax
description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from an individually significant component disposed of or held-for-sale attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes discontinued operations.

label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Basic and Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) of Discontinued Operation, Equity Method Investment Retained after Disposal, before Income Tax
description: Amount before tax of income (loss) of the investee in which an equity method investment is retained after disposal of discontinued operation.

label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Other
description: The tax effect of items occurring during the period that have been charged or credited directly to components of shareholders' equity and are not otherwise defined.

label: Income Tax Examination, Estimate of Possible Loss
description: Estimated amount of loss resulting from an adverse tax position.

label: Income Tax Examination, Interest Accrued
description: The amount of estimated interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

label: Income Tax Examination, Interest Expense
description: The amount of estimated interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

label: Income Tax Examination, Range of Possible Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Income Tax (Expense) Benefit, Continuing Operations, Government Grants
description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit from continuing operations attributable to government grants to the extent recognized as a reduction of income tax expense.

label: IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalBeforeRefundReceived
description: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Extraterritorial Income Exclusion, Amount
description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for extraterritorial income exclusion.

label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit, Amount
description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy.

label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Life Insurance, Amount
description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible life insurance expense.

label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Domestic, Amount
description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in domestic income tax contingency.

label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Other, Amount
description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in other income tax contingencies.

label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, State and Local, Amount
description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in state and local income tax contingency.

label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Investment, Amount
description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to investment tax credit.

label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Foreign, Amount
description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax settlement.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all taxes owed but not paid, including income, property and other taxes.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepayments received from borrowers for taxes and insurance remitted to the appropriate tax authority or insurer on behalf of the borrower.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Broker-Dealer Related Receivables (Payables), Net
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables or payables that result from buying and selling securities for the firm's own account or from acting as an agent or intermediary in the sale of securities.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Client Funds Held
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of client funds held and maintained in custodial and separate accounts, and which are owned by clients or contract holders.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract Receivables, Net
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables arising from the contracting of goods and services, net for uncollectible accounts.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading
description: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges, Investing
description: The increase (decrease) in noncurrent deferred charges, classified as investing activities.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Pension Costs (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Due from Affiliates, Current
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Officers and Stockholders
description: The increase (decrease), during an accounting period, in total obligations owed to the reporting entity's executives and owners.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Other Related Parties, Current
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party payables classified as other, due within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value Adjustments on Other Assets (Liabilities) Carried at Fair Value under Fair Value Option
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value adjustment on other assets (liabilities) carried at fair value under the fair value option on the statement of cash flows of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

label: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of financial instruments used in operating activities, including trading securities, risk management instruments, and other short-term trading instruments.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Finished Goods and Work in Process Inventories
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of finished goods inventory and work in process inventory.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Intangible Assets, Current
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in intangible assets (for example patents and licenses).

label: Increase (Decrease) in Interests Continued to be Held by Transferor, Current
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of the assets created and retained during the securitization of trade receivables, which are not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories and Other Operating Assets
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in inventory, and assets classified as other.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventory for Long-term Contracts or Programs
description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of inventory pertaining to construction, development, or other contracts or programs that initially were expected to take more than one year or the normal operating cycle to complete.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense Reserve
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in liability to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans to Federal Home Loan Banks
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans to another FHLBank.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Long-term Receivables, Current
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due within one year (or one business cycle) of receivables that were originally due beyond one year (or one business cycle).

label: IncreaseDecreaseInManagementAndIncentiveFeesPayable
description: Amount of increase (decrease) management and incentive fees payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Current
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current portion (due within one year or one business cycle) of obligations evidenced by formal promissory notes.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Related Parties
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed by the reporting entry in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Employee-Related Liabilities
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in employer-related costs classified as other and current.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value of other financial instruments used in operating activities.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets and Liabilities, Net
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating assets after deduction of noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities
description: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Operating Activities
description: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities. Another element, Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities, represents cash flows from outstanding checks classified as financing activities.

label: IncreaseDecreaseInPayableForInvestmentPurchased
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in payable for purchase of investment.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Payables to Customers
description: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in amounts payable to customers. The term customers generally excludes other broker-dealers; persons who are principal officers, directors, and stockholders; and persons whose securities or funds are part of the regulatory net capital of the broker-dealer. Another broker-dealer's account can be classified as a customer if the account is carried as an omnibus account in compliance with certain regulations. The accounts of principal officers, directors and stockholders may be combined in the customer captions if they are not material and the combination is disclosed in the oath that is required to accompany the annual audited FOCUS Report.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Other Postretirement Benefits
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes pension benefits.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Insurance
description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits in future periods.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Interest
description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for interest that provides economic benefits in future periods.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Reinsurance Recoverable
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of benefits the ceding insurer expects to recover on insurance policies ceded to other insurance entities as of the balance sheet date for all guaranteed benefit types.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Investments for Operating Activities
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in marketable securities and investments pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Retainage Payable
description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in retainage obligations due by the reporting entity that are payable within one year (or one business cycle).

label: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Lending Payable
description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of the liability pertaining to obligations to return collateral that the entity received when it loaned securities to the counterparty to the transaction.

label: Increase (Decrease) in Unearned Premiums
description: Amount of increase (decrease) unearned premiums written. Excludes portion of unearned premiums amortized into income.

label: (Increase) Decrease in Unearned Premiums, Net
description: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of decrease (increase) in unearned premiums.

label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Accelerated Share Repurchase Agreements
description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of accelerated share repurchase agreements. An accelerated share repurchase program is a combination of transactions that permits an entity to purchase a targeted number of shares immediately with the final purchase price of those shares determined by an average market price over a fixed period of time.

label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Property, Casualty and Liability
description: Amount, after effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for property and casualty insurance contracts.

label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Impairment Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Written off Related to Sale of Business Unit
description: Amount of decrease in indefinite-lived intangible asset from divestiture. Excludes goodwill.

label: Indefinite-Lived Trademarks
description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

label: Initial Franchise Fees
description: The amount of initial franchise fees.

label: Insurance Investment Income
description: Investment income associated with the company's insurance services.

label: Insurance Services Revenue
description: Revenue from insurance services, including net premiums earned, gain on sale of insurance block, agency management fees and insurance contract fees and commissions.

label: Intercompany Foreign Currency Balance, Amount
description: Amount of intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

label: InterestAndDividendIncomeOperatingPaidInKind
description: Amount of interest and dividend income from investment paid in kind, classified as operating.

label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Other
description: Amount of other operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases Held-for-sale
description: The amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including mortgage loans, and interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale.

label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer
description: Interest and fee income generated from consumer loans. Consumer loans are loans to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures. Such loans include residential mortgages, home equity lines-of-credit, automobiles and marine transport loans, credit card transactions, and others.

label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Lease Financing
description: Interest and fee income generated by direct lease financing which consists of an institution owning and leasing personal property for the use of its customers at the customers' specific request.

label: Interest and Fee Income, Nonmortgage Loans and Leases Held-for-sale
description: Amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale, but excluding mortgage loans held-for sale.

label: Interest and Fee Income, Other Loans Held-for-sale
description: Amount of interest and fee income from loans held-for-sale and classified as other.

label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Certificates of Deposits
description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic certificate of deposit liabilities.

label: Interest Expense, Capital Securities
description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on capital securities issued by the reporting entity.

label: Interest Expense, Deposits
description: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all deposits.

label: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased
description: Gross expenses on the purchase of Federal funds at a specified price with a simultaneous agreement to sell the same to the same counterparty at a fixed or determinable price at a future date.

label: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
description: The aggregate expense incurred on federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase. If amounts recognized as payables under repurchase agreements have been offset against amounts recognized as receivables under reverse repurchase agreements and reported as a net amount on the balance sheet, the income and expense from these agreements may be reported on a net basis.

label: Interest Expense, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank Advances, Long-term
description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on long-term borrowings associated with Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances.

label: InterestExpenseInterestBearingLiabilityIncreaseDecrease
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest expense on interest-bearing liability.

label: Interest Expense, Junior Subordinated Debentures
description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on junior subordinated debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

label: Interest Expense, Long-term Debt and Capital Securities
description: Total interest expense on long-term debt and capital securities.

label: InterestExpenseLongTermDebtIncreaseDecrease
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest expense on long-term debt.

label: InterestExpenseMandatorilyRedeemableFinancialInstrumentLiabilityClassified
description: Amount of interest expense recognized on mandatorily redeemable financial instrument issued in form of share classified as liability.

label: Interest Expense, Medium-term Notes
description: Amount of interest expense incurred on medium-term note.

label: Interest Expense, Trust Preferred Securities
description: The amount of interest incurred to a trust which has issued trust-preferred securities. In order to issue trust preferred securities, a sponsor forms a trust by investing a nominal amount of cash to purchase all of the voting common stock of the trust. The trust issues nonvoting, mandatorily redeemable preferred securities to outside investors in exchange for cash. The proceeds received from the issuance of the preferred securities, together with the cash received for issuing the common stock to the sponsor, is then loaned to the sponsor in exchange for a note which has the same terms as the trust preferred securities. Trust preferred securities possesses characteristics of both equity and debt issues and are generally issued by bank holding companies.

label: Interest Income and Fees, Bankers Acceptances, Certificates of Deposit and Commercial Paper
description: Interest and fee income derived from banker's acceptances, certificates of deposit and commercial paper.

label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Trading, Operating
description: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount, on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading); classified as operating.

label: Interest Income, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
description: Interest income derived from securities purchased under agreements to resell. The difference in the price at which the institution buys the securities and resells the securities represents interest for the use of the funds by the other party. Most repurchase and sale agreements involve obligations of the federal government or its agencies, but other financial instruments, such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances and negotiable certificates of deposits are sometimes used in such transactions.

label: Interest Income, Securities, US Treasury
description: Interest income on US treasury securities. US treasury securities are negotiable debt obligations of the US government, secured by its full faith and credit and issued at various schedules and maturities. The income from treasury securities is exempt from state and local, but not federal, taxes. There are three types of securities issued by the US treasury (bonds, bills, and notes), which are distinguished by the amount of time from the initial sale of the bond to maturity.

label: Interest Paid, Discontinued Operations
description: The amount of cash paid during the current period for interest owed on debt associated with discontinued operations.

label: Interest Portion of Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
description: Amount necessary to reduce minimum lease payments to present value for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments at Fair Value, Net
description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

label: Interest Receivable, Noncurrent
description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of noncurrent interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

label: Interim Period, Costs Not Allocable Amount, First Item
description: Amount of first item of cost and expense incurred during interim period not readily identified with activity or benefit of other interim period and charged to interim period in which incurred.

label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory, Current (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Inventory, LIFO Reserve
description: Amount by which inventory stated at last-in first-out (LIFO) is less than (in excess of) inventory stated at other inventory cost methods.

label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve, Period Charge
description: The change in the inventory reserve representing the cumulative difference in cost between the first in, first out and the last in, first out inventory valuation methods, which change has been reflected in the statement of income during the period.

label: Inventory, Operative Builders
description: The net carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the sum of the various components of an operative builder's inventory, including finished homes. Operative builders primarily consist of entities that develop land, construct residential homes and commercial and industrial buildings thereon, and sell them to home buyers and operators of the commercial and industrial properties.

label: Inventory, Operative Builders, Other
description: Amount of inventory used in the development of real estate classified as other.

label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Gross
description: Gross amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed.

label: Inventory, Real Estate, Improvements
description: Represents improvements to real estate during development for ultimate sale to third parties. Improvements may consist of project infrastructure and other expenditures necessary to completion of the development project which is generally of a long-term nature.

label: Inventory, Real Estate, Mortgage Loans Held in Inventory
description: Represents mortgage loans held in inventory primarily for sale to others (third parties, businesses, legal entities) in the ordinary course of business.

label: Inventory, Supplies, Net of Reserves
description: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of products used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process, which may or may not become part of the final product. May also include items used in the storage, presentation or transportation of physical goods.

label: Inventory Valuation Reserves
description: Amount of valuation reserve for inventory.

label: Investment Banking Revenue
description: Includes (1) underwriting revenue (the spread between the resale price received and the cost of the securities and related expenses) generated through the purchasing, distributing and reselling of new issues of securities (alternatively, could be a secondary offering of a large block of previously issued securities); and (2) fees earned for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, and other types of financial advisory services.

label: Investment Company, Contractual Fee Waived
description: Amount of fee contractually waived by investment company.

label: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings
Investment Company, Distributable Earnings (Loss), Accumulated Appreciation (Depreciation)
description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) from unrealized appreciation (depreciation) of investment company.

label: Investment Company, Financial Support to Investee Contractually Required, Amount
description: Amount of financial support committed by investment company to investee that is contractually required.

label: Investment Company, General Partner Advisory Service
description: Amount of expense for advisory service from general partner.

label: Investment Company, Incentive Fee to Average Net Assets
description: Percentage of incentive fee expense to average net assets.

label: InvestmentCompanyIncreaseDecreaseFromShareTransaction
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity from change in number of shares or units by investment company.

label: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss), Per Share
description: Per-basic-share or unit amount, after investment expense, of dividend and interest investment income (loss) from investment held by investment company.

label: Investment Company, Registration Expense
description: Amount of registration fee expense for issuance of shares or units.

label: Investment Company, Tax Return of Capital Distribution
description: Amount of distribution in excess of tax-basis earnings and profit of investment company.

label: Investment Company, Total Return
description: Percentage increase (decrease) in fund net asset value, assuming reinvestment of dividends and capital gain distributions.

label: Investment Income, Amortization of Premium
description: Amount of amortization of purchase premium on nonoperating securities.

label: InvestmentIncomeOperatingTaxExpenseBenefit
description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on investment income classified as operating. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

label: Investment Owned, Balance, Contracts
description: Balance held at close of period in number of contracts.

label: Investment Owned, Other than Securities, Loaned for Short Sales, at Fair Value (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Investments and Cash
description: Sum of investments and unrestricted cash as of the balance sheet date.

label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, Amount of Equity
Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value, Gross Additions
description: Gross additions to the investment in and advance to the affiliate.

label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, Balance, Principal Amount
LIFO Inventory Amount
description: The amount of LIFO (last in first out) inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is also valued using different valuation methods.

label: Land under Purchase Options, Not Recorded
description: Discloses the total purchase price of land option agreements that were not recorded.

label: Lease Incentive, Payable
description: This item represents an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease.

label: Lease Incentive Receivable, Current
description: This item represents the current receivable for an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease. The receivable is due within one year. For classified balance sheets, this element represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

label: Lessor, Direct Financing Lease, Assumptions and Judgments, Value of Underlying Asset, Amount
description: Amount lessor expects from underlying asset following end of direct financing lease term.

label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Assumptions and Judgments, Value of Underlying Asset, Amount
description: Amount lessor expects from underlying asset following end of operating lease term.

label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Lease Not yet Commenced, Assumption and Judgment, Value of Underlying Asset, Amount
description: Amount lessor expects from underlying asset following end of operating lease term for lease that has not yet commenced.

label: Leveraged Leases, Income (Loss)
description: The total recognized during the period for income on leases meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases.

label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Deferred Income
description: The estimated portion of pretax income and investment tax credit remaining to be allocated to income over the lease term.

label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Investment in Leveraged Leases, Net
description: The net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases including deferred taxes.

label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Nonrecourse Debt Service
description: The portion of rentals receivable applicable to principal and interest on the nonrecourse debt.

label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Rental Receivables, Net
description: This element represents leveraged lease rentals receivable, net of that portion of the rental applicable to principal and interest on the nonrecourse debt.

label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Residual Value of Leased Assets
description: The estimate of the value of the leased asset at the end of the lease term.

label: Liabilities and Partners' Capital (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure, Nonrecurring (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Liabilities, Other than Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
description: Aggregated carrying amounts of obligations as of the balance sheet date, excluding long-term debt, incurred as part of the normal operations that are expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities.

label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise
description: Total amount of liabilities subject to compromise.

label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Capital Lease Obligations and Accrued Interest
description: The amount of capital lease obligations and related accrued interest included in liabilities subject to compromise.

label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Environmental Contingencies
description: The amount of environmental remediation liabilities included in liabilities subject to compromise.

label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Period Increase (Decrease)
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in liabilities subject to compromise.

label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Gross
description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of reserves for the costs of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims, before estimated recoveries from reinsurers.

label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Net, Incurred Loss
description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims.

label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
description: The aggregate amount of policy reserves (provided for future obligations including unpaid claims and claims adjustment expenses) and policy benefits (liability for future policy benefits) as of the balance sheet date; grouped amount of all the liabilities associated with the company's insurance policies.

label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Period Expense (Income)
description: Amount of expense (income) recognized due to changes in the accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events.

label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Business Acquisitions
description: Amount, after deduction of reinsurance recovery, of increase (decrease) in cost of settling unpaid claim acquired in business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, claim incurred but not reported.

label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Current Year (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Prior Years (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
description: Amount of foreign currency gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the cost of settling unpaid claims after deduction of reinsurance recoveries. Includes, but is not limited to, claims which have been incurred but not reported.

label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Gross (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims Current Year (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims, Prior Years (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Change in Value
description: The change in cash surrender or contract value during the period which adjusted the amount of premiums paid in determining the expense or income recognized under the contract for the period.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMaturingAfterRollingYearFive
description: Fair value of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMaturingInNextRollingTwelveMonths
description: Fair value of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMaturingInRollingYearFive
description: Fair value of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMaturingInRollingYearFour
description: Fair value of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMaturingInRollingYearThree
description: Fair value of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMaturingInRollingYearTwo
description: Fair value of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value
description: Fair value amount of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method.

label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Face Value
description: Face value (death benefits) of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodFaceValueMaturingAfterRollingYearFive
description: Face value of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodFaceValueMaturingInNextRollingTwelveMonths
description: Face value of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Face Value, Maturing in Rolling Year Five
description: Face value of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Face Value, Maturing in Rolling Year Four
description: Face value of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Face Value, Maturing in Rolling Year Three
description: Face value of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Face Value, Maturing in Rolling Year Two
description: Face value of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Number of Contracts
description: Number of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodNumberOfContractsMaturingAfterRollingYearFive
description: Number of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodNumberOfContractsMaturingInNextRollingTwelveMonths
description: Number of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodNumberOfContractsMaturingInRollingYearFive
description: Number of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodNumberOfContractsMaturingInRollingYearFour
description: Number of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodNumberOfContractsMaturingInRollingYearThree
description: Number of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: LifeSettlementContractsFairValueMethodNumberOfContractsMaturingInRollingYearTwo
description: Number of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: Life Settlement Contracts, Investment Method, Face Value
description: Face value (death benefits) of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the investment method.

label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Members' Equity, Unit-based Payment Arrangement
description: Amount of increase (decrease) in members' equity for unit-based payment arrangement issued by limited liability company (LLC).

label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Preferred Unit, Issuance Value
description: Stated value of preferred units of ownership issued by a limited liability company (LLC).

label: Line of Credit Assumed
description: The fair value of line of credit assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

label: Line of Credit Facility, Collateral Fees, Amount
description: Amount of the fees associated with providing collateral for the credit facility.

label: Line of Credit Facility, Decrease, Repayments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Line of Credit Facility, Increase, Accrued Interest
description: Increase for accrued, but unpaid interest on the credit facility for the period.

label: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment
description: Amount of the required periodic payments of both interest and principal.

label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Remeasurement, Gain (Loss) on Items Previously Not Recognized
description: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of other item not previously recognized but expected to either be sold or used to settle liability in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance, Covered
description: Amount of allowance for loan and lease losses covered by loss sharing agreements.

label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Commitments to Purchase or Sell
description: Amount of financing receivable commitment to purchase or sell.

label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Mortgage (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Covered
description: Aggregate gross carrying amount of loans and leases receivable covered by loss sharing agreements.

label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Allowance for Loan Losses (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, at Carrying Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Average Investment (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, End of Period, in Allowance for Loan Loss (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, End of Period, Not in Allowance for Loan Loss (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Interest Income Recognized (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Interest Income Recognized, Change in Present Value Attributable to Passage of Time
description: The amount of interest income on impaired and nonperforming loans that is due to the change in present value attributable to the passage of time.

label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Troubled Debt, Interest Income
description: The gross interest income that would have been recorded in the period on troubled debt restructurings, if the loans had been current in accordance with their original terms and had been outstanding throughout the period or since origination, if held for part of the period.

label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered
description: Net carrying amount of loans and leases receivable covered by loss sharing agreements.

label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Other, Allowance (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Collections (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Loans (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Loans Payable to Bank, Current
description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of current portion of long-term loans payable to bank due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

label: Loans Receivable, Gross, Commercial, Acquisition (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Net, Not Part of Disposal Group, Commercial, Real Estate (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Period Increase (Decrease)
description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of increase (decrease) in financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

label: Loans Receivable with Variable Rates of Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Long Lived Assets Held-for-sale, Proceeds from Sale (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Years Two and Three
description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the second and third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal Remainder of Fiscal Year
description: Amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year ended.

label: LongTermDebtAverageAmountOutstanding
description: Average amount outstanding of long-term debt.

label: Long-term Debt, Components, Mortgage Loans (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Long-term Notes Payable, Current and Noncurrent (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
